answer: SWOT Analysis for Cambridge-Trinity Mixed-Use Buildings: STRENGTHS: Established mixed-use property with 49 apartment units and 4 retail suites in urban Portland location. THREATS: Civil unrest and homeless population impacts. Downtown retail market distress with business closures. The NOI Multiplier (Price/NOI) can be calculated from the Income Approach as $4,930,000 ÷ $382,446 = 12.89. This represents the inverse of the capitalization rate (1 ÷ 0.0775 = 12.90). The multiplier is reasonable and consistent with the market-extracted cap rate of 7.75%, indicating the property trades at approximately 12.9 times its net operating income, which aligns with comparable investment properties in the market [Page 73].

The capitalization rate of 7.75% is well-supported through comparable sales analysis [Page 70-72]. Four comparable sales with cap rates ranging from 5.19% to 7.60% were adjusted for income stability, building class, and development size, resulting in an adjusted range of 7.27% to 7.81%. The concluded 7.75% rate falls within the upper-middle portion of this range, which is reasonable for the subject's characteristics including moderate rent levels and mixed-use nature.
transcription: Cap Rate: 7.75% - well-supported by comparable analysis
